    - Pots, jugs and bowls, and a laugh if you want one. What can I do for you, *Player*?

    - I can tell what a pot is for before it leaves the wheel. This one wants to be a soup bowl. Hear it? No? Ha! Neither can anyone else.

    - That jug on the top shelf was hers. I never sell it and I never use it. The mayor sits on the stool by my door sometimes, and we do not need to say much.
